summary: New exact prescribed-measure L1 defect J equals finite-tail-maximum objective loss; sufficient analytic continuity bridge and precise remaining USC-spike condition are proved as scoped implications.
detailedSummary: For every eligible arbitrary-support mu, the Borel limsup u is mu-integrable, tail suprema converge to it in L1(mu), and int|a_j-u|mu tends to J=int u mu-(e-D(mu))>=0. Uniform maximality loss of finite maxima tends exactly to J. Vanishing, sequence independence and relation to K are not asserted. Any full-point USC excess must occur through arbitrarily small-capacity open spikes; continuous tail suprema would yield original G representation and MAu=nu, but the antecedent and nu=mu remain unproved.
text:
Exact prescribed-measure L1 and finite-tail-maximum objective defects, with a precise relaxation obstruction. This uses only earlier own notes n1,n2 and their explicit analytic-foundation boundary. No support condition on prescribed mu is added.

Let u=limsup a_n, S_j=sup_(n>=j)a_n, M_(j,q)=max(a_j,...,a_q), e=lim Ea_n, B=D(mu), r=e-B. Unlike positivity, full-mu integrability of this ACTUAL Borel u can now be proved. Every actual normalized M has E(M)>=-C and satisfies int(-M)mu<=B-E(M). At fixed j, M_(j,q) increases to S_j and is bounded in absolute value by the finite continuous -a_j. Countable dominated convergence gives int(-S_j)mu<=B-L_j. Now -S_j increases to -u and L_j decreases to e; ordinary SEQUENTIAL monotone convergence gives
int(-u)mu<=B-e<infinity.
Thus u is finite mu-almost everywhere, including that its potential -infinity set is mu-null. Also int(S_j-u)mu tends to zero. This proves ordered L1 continuity for these Borel tail suprema without recognizing them as psh.

Set s=int u mu and J=s-r. Since S_j>=a_j and int a_j mu tends to r, passage to the limits gives s>=r. Since u<=0, s<=0. Hence 0<=J<=B-e. Pointwise (a_j-u)_+<=S_j-u outside the null pole set, so int(a_j-u)_+mu tends to zero. The exact elementary identity
|a_j-u|=u-a_j+2(a_j-u)_+
has finite integrals and proves
lim_j int|a_j-u|mu=J.
Therefore a_j converges to its actual Borel limsup in L1(mu) IF AND ONLY IF J=0. Vanishing has NOT been proved. Neither J's independence of the fast sequence nor its equality with the earlier K=B-D(nu) is asserted.

J is also the exact loss of the prescribed-measure objective in the finite-tail-maximum procedure. Put g_j=int(S_j-a_j)mu, so g_j tends to J; z_(j,q)=int(M_(j,q)-a_j)mu increases to g_j; d_(j,q)=E(M_(j,q))-Ea_j lies in[0,R_j]. The exact identity
B-Fmu(M_(j,q))=epsilon_j+z_(j,q)-d_(j,q)
gives epsilon_j+g_j-R_j<=sup_(q>=j)[B-Fmu(M_(j,q))]<=epsilon_j+g_j. Thus
lim_j sup_(q>=j)[B-Fmu(M_(j,q))]=J,
lim_j lim_q Fmu(M_(j,q))=B-J.
Uniform full-mu maximality of ALL finite tail maxima is equivalent to J=0. Energy/I/MA controls from n2 prove their uniform maximality for nu, but alone do not prove this vanishing for mu. This diagnoses exactly the missing full-objective step without claiming an analytic counterexample or replacing the original equation.

There is also a proved necessary form of any USC-relaxation excess. Suppose a full point x has R(x)>ell(x)+4eta, eta>0, for the common ordinary USC relaxation. Since x is outside N, for all sufficiently large m it is outside O_m, |a_m(x)-ell(x)|<eta and 2^(1-m)<eta. Continuity gives an ordinary W_m containing x with a_m<ell(x)+2eta. Outside O_m, telescoping implies a_n<ell(x)+3eta on W_m for every n>=m. But the defining upper-tail regularization of R implies that every neighborhood of x in W_m and every tail j>=m has a point y and n>=j with a_n(y)>ell(x)+4eta. Such y must lie in O_m. Therefore for every j>=m,
x belongs to the ordinary closure of O_m intersect W_m intersect {S_j>ell(x)+4eta}.
These sets are ordinary open and have Cap_(C+k)<=P_m for m>=k. The residual gap, if present, must be witnessed by arbitrarily small-capacity ordinary open spike sets accumulating at x. This is a necessary condition, not a proof that excess occurs or vanishes. No ordinary-neighborhood exclusion follows from small capacity.

A sufficient ANALYTIC representation implication can be proved exactly, without treating it as a solution. IF each actual S_j is continuous on all X, the increasing finite continuous maxima converge uniformly to S_j by the compact-Hausdorff Dini finite-cover argument. Entire minimal CLD uniform closure gives S_j in C; product continuity gives E(S_j)=L_j. The actual decreasing S_j then presents u in original G with E(u)=e. Passing bounded products at fixed j in I(a_j,M_(j,q))<=R_j gives I(a_j,S_j)<=R_j, so MA(S_j) converges weakly to nu. The original generated operator is thus MA(u)=nu. Its mu objective is B-J. The continuity antecedent is unproved, and even this representation alone does not identify nu with mu.

The generated operator fact used in that implication is reconstructed rather than taken as a grant: compact strict domination compares any two continuous decreasing presentations plus arbitrary positive constants, proving canonical energy and energies of convex combinations. These energies are cubic polynomials on each finite simplex; convergence at finite unisolvent nodes gives coefficient convergence. For fixed w in C, with P_n(t)=E((1-t)c_n+tw), A_n(t)=E(tc_n), first variation gives int w MA(c_n)=P_n'(0)+A_n'(1). Density and common mass2 extend canonical weak limits to every continuous test, and Riesz gives the actual generated Radon measure. Passing tangent first with bounded competitors proves finite full dual, so sequential integrability precedes all unbounded moments. The ordered cocycle then gives int v MA(v)=lim int c_n MA(c_n) and D(MA(v))=E(v)-int v MA(v). This construction requires an already actual continuous decreasing presentation. It does not manufacture one for S_j, U_j, R or the Borel u.

The complete arguments are in standalone.tex, labels new:Lone,new:lostmax,new:spikes,new:bridge. Still unproved are global analytic positivity/recognition, all-point and pole representatives in an adequate domain, vanishing of the prescribed-measure defects, legitimate envelope/variation inputs and MA(actual analytic u)=EVERY eligible mu. Classical recognition alone would not establish original minimal CLD/G membership. The unchanged original P16.7 remains OPEN; candidate=false.
